scope_note: Held-out source-audited evaluation on N=54 queries balanced across Dependency / Impact / Reasoning with multi-relevance judgments. The executable pre-ranking audit verifies every label against current source anchors. This is not independently labeled by multiple humans and has not been replicated on an external codebase, so it is not publication-ready.

split.name: held-out-evaluation
split.freezeRule: The dataset and metric protocol are committed before any ranking output is admitted.

labeling.boundary: The executable verifier reads only the frozen dataset and source anchors before ranking. This is source-audited independent verification, not independent multi-human annotation.

claim_boundary.reason: The corpus clears the 50-query and multi-relevance implementation gates but still lacks independent multi-human annotators and external-codebase replication.

systems.name: bm25
systems.label: BM25 (skipped — not shipped in absorb-service)
systems.reason: No standalone BM25 primitive exists in @holoscript/absorb-service. The keyword-only system above is the closest in-tree lexical baseline (token overlap on symbol name + file + signature).

notes: Legacy structural-floor mode: vectors encode symbol structure without name-derived HoloEmbed subwords.
Keyword-only acts as the lexical/BM25-analog baseline; a true BM25 implementation is not shipped in absorb-service.
No LLM is invoked — the engine returns ranked enriched results, not generated answers, so accuracy is measured on retrieval not synthesis.
IMPORTANT: StructuralEmbeddingProvider encodes AST-structural features rather than NL-text semantics. Treat these results as a legacy floor.
Precision@5 uses the conventional fixed denominator of five. Queries have two to five audited relevant files, so the maximum attainable per-query precision depends on the frozen relevance set.
Confidence intervals are deterministic non-parametric bootstrap intervals over held-out queries. Delta intervals are paired against the keyword-only baseline.
